name: 骑射横扫
description: 仅向上下左右四个正方向冲刺至多7格，路径敌人受到100%攻击力物理伤害；冲刺会被墙体或 trap 阻挡。动能5：冲刺后直接选择本次冲刺终点左侧或右侧的相邻地格，确定侧射方向；冲刺路径每格向该方向4格内的敌人造成5点伤害。射击可穿透角色，但会被掩体或墙体阻挡（不伤害冲刺格敌人）。动能7：路径伤害+2。
code: function executeSkill(context){var c=context.piece,b=context.battle,pos=selectTarget({type:'grid',range:7,filter:'all'});if(!pos||pos.needsTargetSelection)return pos;var dx=Math.sign(pos.x-c.x),dy=Math.sign(pos.y-c.y),steps=Math.max(Math.abs(pos.x-c.x),Math.abs(pos.y-c.y));if((dx===0&&dy===0)||(dx!==0&&dy!==0)||steps>7)return {success:false,message:'请选择7格内上下左右方向'};var last=null,pathHit=[],pathCells=[],momentum=c.momentum||0;for(var i=1;i<=steps;i++){var x=c.x+dx*i,y=c.y+dy*i,tile=b.map.tiles.find(function(q){return q.x===x&&q.y===y;});if(!tile||!tile.props||tile.props.walkable===false||tile.props.type==='wall'||tile.props.type==='trap'||tile.props.type==='hole')return {success:false,message:'冲刺路径被墙体、陷阱或不可通行地形阻挡'};pathCells.push({x:x,y:y});if(!b.pieces.some(function(p){return p.currentHp>0&&p.x===x&&p.y===y&&p.instanceId!==c.instanceId;}))last={x:x,y:y};var pathVictims=b.pieces.filter(function(p){return p.currentHp>0&&p.ownerPlayerId!==c.ownerPlayerId&&p.x===x&&p.y===y;});pathVictims.forEach(function(p){var r=dealDamage(c,p,c.attack+(momentum>=7?2:0),'physical',b,context.skill.id);pathHit.push(p.name+'(-'+r.damage+')');});}if(!last)return {success:false,message:'没有可落脚的空格'};if(momentum>=5){c.statusTags=c.statusTags||[];c.statusTags.push({id:'shadow-ride-sweep-side-'+c.instanceId+'-'+Date.now(),type:'shadow-ride-sweep-side',name:'骑射横扫侧射',pathCells:pathCells,dx:dx,dy:dy,left:{x:pos.x+dy,y:pos.y-dx},right:{x:pos.x-dy,y:pos.y+dx},currentDuration:0,currentUses:1,visible:false});}c.x=last.x;c.y=last.y;return {success:true,message:'骑射横扫至('+last.x+','+last.y+')'+(pathHit.length?'，路径命中'+pathHit.join('、'):'')};}
